items.description: The tidal Rivers Bure, Ant and Thurne
items.message:
High tides tomorrow morning may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible early tomorrow morning on Monday 02 November. 
We expect to see high water levels around Potter Heigham, Wroxham boat yards and Ferry Road in Horning. Levels can take several hours to peak. We are not expecting the situation to escalate, or to issue any further warning messages at this time. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water.  
This message will be updated by 10:00AM on Monday 02 November or as the situation changes.
